reference.compatibility: Exact original Base, source/seed, tokenization, five views, removed transform, masks, Base16/removed4, optimizer, precision and candidate clock; mismatch stops admission, no automatic baseline rerun

design.single_factor: After first complete CE<0.1, switch next slot from H+E to E subject to candidate complete CE<0.1; irreversible

objective.H: mean_answer ReLU(logit(a_star)-logit(a)), a_star=max(p0_full(y),0.95), stable log masses
objective.E: mean over two concepts ReLU(log(1.01) - mean concept tokens [log p_full(y) - log p_removed(y)])
objective.concept_reduction: equal mean of two concepts after per-concept token mean; subtraction before mean exactly as original gate
objective.candidate_Armijo: same current phase objective and same two views; EVIDENCE additionally requires complete five-view native CE<0.1
objective.coefficient_rationale: unit coefficient on two mean log-scale deficits; no gradient balancing or tuning
objective.margin_rationale: predeclared 1 percent geometric-mean probability ratio above equality; engineering target not clinical threshold; not fitted to prior score items
objective.HC: FIT: original HE H+E two-view objective; EVIDENCE: E only with complete candidate CE<0.1

two_phase.trigger: initial complete CE<0.1 gives switch_slot=0; otherwise first accepted formal update with complete CE<0.1
two_phase.admission: always H+E temporary write, rolled back; never changes formal phase
two_phase.never_crosses: all20 slots remain FIT; report evidence phase not entered
two_phase.crosses_at_slot20: record transition but zero evidence slots; no extra slots
two_phase.candidate_CE: five original full FIT views weights .5,.125,.125,.125,.125, actual candidate native FP16, FP64 CE reduction
two_phase.nonfinite: reject or mechanical fail closed; never accept
two_phase.rejection: restore native; master/memory/phase unchanged; consume slot

shared.source_end_birth_rules: unchanged SH00; all qualification gates required

gates.evidence_gap_interpretation: source sensitivity qualification only, not external protection/clinical correctness
gates.high_loss_frozen: CE>=.1 AND final10 slots all zero

primary: complete CE <0.1 AND ten finite strictly positive margins
T0/T1G all correct AND original T2G nondegradation AND zero individual damage AND full scoring
secondary: per-concept full and removed logp initial/final and each slot; split margin change
evidence training target attained count at log(1.01), descriptive only
actual removed KL, accepted/rejected/zero and gradient cosine
mechanism_endpoints.interpretation: Positive gap may arise by lowering removed confidence. Always show both sides. No unique mechanism claim, no causal/clinical/population inference. Training target is not a replacement acceptance threshold.

every_slot: ten scalar full_logp/removed_logp/margin, evidence deficit and target attainment; no new labels
phase before/after, first_fit_slot and complete CE
evidence gradient norm and directional derivatives along free capped step and projected capped step; native candidate and accepted step
each native candidate ten concept full/removed logp, margins, full CE and actual E change; all are current-source diagnostics
initial_and_final: separate hinge and direct evidence parameter-gradient norms and cosine; ten counted backwards
ten per-view/concept mean logp(full), mean logp(removed), margin and finite flag; scalar only
diagnostics.direction_definition: same selected two-view E as objective; unscaled evidence gradient, free=-eta*clipped objective gradient with original norm cap, projected=solver post-retraction/cap, native=actual candidateFP16-oldFP16; log exact vectors used, no diagnostic update
diagnostics.diagnostic_budget: at most one additional backward per FIT slot/admission; reuse unclipped objective gradient in EVIDENCE; all counted in original300 cap; no evaluation gradients

evaluation.unknown_bounds: combine same payload variables before exact paired bounds
before_scoring: each final native fresh reload2 exact
completion: publication SHA and anonymous access verified

decision_rules.unchanged_gates_pass: report single-source success, stop after delivery; no next experiment
decision_rules.no_switch: FIT never reached CE gate; stop without extra slots
decision_rules.evidence_phase_stalls: report actual direction derivatives, candidate rejection and native effects; do not tune
decision_rules.fit_margin_pass_protection_fail: source policy not sufficient for external protection; no test-derived anchors
decision_rules.any_gate_fail: report failed AND gates, stop; no threshold changes or automatic restart
decision_rules.mechanical_or_data_failure: preserve all costs and evidence; no uncertain replay/reinstall

prelaunch_requirements: separate executor snapshot; never edit frozen HM/HU
production CPU objective/gradient oracle, native rollback, formal20-slot path, state recipe, counters, report and no-launch guards
historical compatibility; storage and GPU admission; Base3 and real-VLM admission before slots
neutral process command lines and ps/nvidia-smi checks at future launch
no failed Judge retry; no budget reset; no unknown-state replay
